status_legend.in_progress: The feature is the current active task (at most one at a time).
status_legend.blocked: Work cannot continue until the blocker in `notes` is resolved.
status_legend.passing: Required verification ran and the evidence is recorded.

features.title: Harness adoption and tooling
features.user_visible_behavior: A fresh session can clock in from AGENTS.md, PROGRESS.md and this file; ./init.sh, pnpm harness:doctor and pnpm check pass; tokens cannot be committed (pnpm secrets:check).

features.title: Survey and sync of the repositories that use the harness
features.user_visible_behavior: Each cycle the updater finds the owner's repositories that depend on @eemelinen/harness (or the configured list), records per consumer its pinned version, update/canary settings, merge policy, retro settings, guard and allowedTools counts, default-branch CI, open retro issues and, for checkouts on this machine, its runs.jsonl summary; keeps its own clones of harness and every consumer in /data; and prints the survey as a table.

features.title: Triage of harness issues with a read-only session
features.user_visible_behavior: Open retro and quarantine issues opened by the owner, without a verdict (or reopened, or commented since), are triaged one by one: a read-only Claude session with the survey and the clones answers accepted, rejected or needs-human with per-consumer reasoning. The verdict is posted as a comment and an updater:* label; a refined feature block replaces the old one; rejected issues are closed as not planned, except quarantine issues, which become needs-human. Observe mode only logs.

features.title: Build runner, daemon and container
features.user_visible_behavior: In full mode, an accepted issue that is not queued starts one harness loop run in the harness clone, at most build.maxPerDay per day and only while the harness config gates its intake on updater:accepted. The daemon runs a cycle every pollMinutes under a lock; updater status, survey, issues, triage and health work in the container, which docker compose builds and starts with the tokens from .env and the host projects mounted read-only.

features.title: Go live
features.user_visible_behavior: The container runs against real GitHub: observe mode logs verdicts for real issues, triage mode posts them, the harness config sets retro.intakeLabel to updater:accepted, and full mode builds an accepted issue into a harness PR.
verification: manual: the maintainer fills in .env, runs docker compose up -d --build in observe mode, checks the logged verdicts, switches to triage and then full after the harness intake gate is merged
